'''2009 Coruscant Regionals Trevin Tyson DS Look Sir, Droids (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Trevin Tyson]] at [[2009 Coruscant Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Look Sir, Droids (V) (Virtual Set 15: Galactic Frontier)|OVS15-54-Look_Sir_Droids-remaster.webp|label=Look Sir, Droids (V)}}
* '''Deck name:''' I hate wookiees
* '''Username:''' Tyson
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
